verdict.rationale: iTerm2 documents a Python package for scripts that control and extend the app (python-api docs, GitHub 'full automation and customization via Python'). It also documents AppleScript support for launching the app and opening sessions, and a user praises the Python API from real use (theme switching). The 404s on OpenAPI paths are not a contradiction, since this is a local scripting API, not an HTTP service. Missing for 10: machine-readable or agent-oriented docs (llms.txt and markdown docs both return 404), and the pack shows little of the API reference's depth.
